caption: Ponte di Ariccia and Palazzo Chigi, Ariccia
composition: Two-tier brick viaduct spanning the valley below the Baroque cliff town and twin-towered church · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The camera faces the great two-tier brick viaduct of the Ponte di Ariccia spanning the valley in the lower half of the frame. Above on the right, the Baroque cliff town rises with its twin-towered church and dome, framed by cypresses and umbrella pines. The 14:17 afternoon sun warms the brick under a clear blue sky.
